Two known inherited mathpix OCR artifacts were left exactly as produced (per step_2/extract.md's 'keep math exactly as Mathpix produced it, even if broken') for stage 5 to verify against the source PDF rather than silently corrected here: sol_1.11 part b's mass-transfer line multiplies by '1.85 x 10^12' where part a computed n='1.87 x 10^12' (a pre-existing inconsistency already present in the official solutions manual's own printed text, not a mathpix artifact - left untouched, faithful to source per Rule 1); sol_1.21's charge computation prints '6.67 x 10^9 C' immediately followed by '= 6.67 nC' in the same derivation (self-contradictory by 18 orders of magnitude - almost certainly mathpix misreading a superscript minus sign in the source PDF), and the source text never states the sphere's charge is negative despite the field pointing radially inward. Both flagged here rather than 'fixed' at this stage, since stage 5 is where corrections get verified against the actual PDF page image and recorded as a proper Correction, not stage 2.

Hand-authored plain static HTML/CSS (no Claude Design canvas), adapted from maths-12-5's own working latex.py/render_page.py (the most recent, most bug-fixed prior chapter) rather than built from scratch, per step_9/PROMPT.md. English throughout (lang="en", LABEL_EN pill labels, Example/Question prefixes, two sections: Examples then Questions and Solutions - no per-प्रश्नावली sub-sectioning needed, unlike the Maths chapters this was adapted from, since NCERT Physics chapters have one combined EXERCISES section). CSS started from solutions-chapter-1.css (the shared base) plus only the accumulated additions this chapter genuinely needs (.s23 flex-column fix, .s81/.s82 replacing unsafe .s22, .s86-89 plain-box answer variants, .s90/.s92/.s93 glued-fraction and aligned-block wrappers, break-inside:avoid on .s31/.s90/.s14, the 700px mobile breakpoint) - dropped the maths-12-5-specific matrix/determinant CSS (.s94-98/.sD1-3) entirely as irrelevant dead weight for this chapter's arithmetic-only content. Before trusting the reused converter, grepped this chapter's own 06_simplify/chapter.simplified.en.md for every \[a-zA-Z]+ command actually used and diffed against the converter's macro table per step_9/PROMPT.md's explicit mandate - found and fixed real gaps a Maths chapter's own converter never needed: epsilon/varepsilon (permittivity, 58x combined), rho/sigma/tau, capital Delta/Phi, \hat and ec accent commands (unit vectors/vector notation, 20x combined), sim/gg/approx/AA/angle. Two chapter-specific symbol overrides after checking every occurrence in this chapter's own content first (never speculatively): \circ -> degree sign, not function composition (all 9 occurrences are angle degrees); \in -> epsilon, not set membership (all 4 occurrences are a mathpix OCR artifact misreading epsilon-zero, confirmed against the surrounding "Permittivity of free space" text each time). Ran a full read-back pass of the converter against all 446 real math spans in the chapter before trusting it (zero stray backslashes / unhandled commands). Caught and fixed six further issues during visual QA (not caught by any automated check): (1) topic-label text fracturing mid-word in the narrow badge column (CSS overflow-wrap/word-break fix); (2) "i.e." and "Fig. N" sentence-splitter mis-fires treating those periods as sentence boundaries (abbreviation-guard fix); (3) the telescoped-enumeration prompt-stripping helper computing the last clause's end position from a separately-.strip()'d copy's length rather than tracking the position directly in the original string, leaving a stray "?" behind on a 4-clause item (ex_1.11); (4) on the mobile breakpoint specifically, a negative exponent/coefficient's ASCII hyphen wrapping away from its own digit (a plain "-" is a valid browser soft-break point, like "well-known") - fixed with a non-breaking hyphen; (5) the ec accent's combining-character rendering as a tofu box in this font stack (STIX Two Text has no glyph for U+20D7, unlike the far more common combining circumflex \hat already used) - switched to a CSS-positioned arrow; (6) the boxed-answer blob-vs-plain-box length threshold stripping entire "$...$" spans as zero-length before counting, so a multi-clause answer written as several separate math spans (ex_1.8's E_A/E_B/E_C) always chose the organic-blob box regardless of actual rendered length - fixed to count the digits/units inside each span. Also caught and fixed, via the proper verify->simplify->format->tag propagation (not a stage-9 patch), a genuine stage-2 transcription error surfaced while reading q_1.14's prompt closely: \hat{\mathbf{1}} (digit one) where both source PDFs clearly show the unit vector i-hat - see the separate verify_correction/format_correction manifest entries for that fix. Full manual read-back performed per step_9/PROMPT.md's mandatory, non-automatable check: every question and final_answer in 06_simplify/chapter.simplified.en.md read against the rendered page (12 examples, 23 exercises, all multi-part items individually), plus a numeric-token script cross-check (all found). Zero browser console errors on the rendered page.
